2228-4279-5933.easyPrerequisites:
You control at least one additional creature.
Your life total is at least 2.
An opponent controls a creature.
2228-4279-5933.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing a creature, targeting any creature an opponent controls.
When the sacrificed creature dies, Popular Egotist triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on a creature an opponent controls, and causing you to draw a card.
Hapatra triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.
2228-4279-5933.notes: You may also repeat this loop whenever a creature enters the battlefield under an opponent's control. The lock will end once you've drawn your library.

585-1429-3698-5402.description:
Activate Grinding Station by tapping it and sacrificing Lesser Masticore.
When Lesser Masticore dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Lesser Masticore enters the battlefield, Captain Storm and Grinding Station trigger.
Resolve the Grinding Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Captain Storm trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Lesser Masticore.
Remove a +1/+1 and a -1/-1 counter from Lesser Manticore as a state-based action.
Resolve the Grinding Station ability from step, causing target player to mill three cards.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with three or more +1/+1 counters on it

1017-2122-4029.description:
Activate Mindless Automaton by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to draw a card.
Wizard Class triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on Mindless Automaton due to Benevolent Hydra
Repeat.

1987-2239-6573.easyPrerequisites: You control an artifact, creature or land that can enter and tap to produce at least {U}
1987-2239-6573.notablePrerequisites: You've cast a commander from the command zone two or more times this game.
1987-2239-6573.description:
Activate a mana-producing permanent by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, blinking the mana-producing permanent and Ardent Elementalist.
When Ardent Elementalist enters, it triggers, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
1987-2239-6573.notes: You must blink a land as your mana-producing permanent to get infinite landfall triggers.

129-1409-3755-4885.description:
Activate Deadeye Navigator by tapping it, adding {U}.
Kinnan triggers, adding {U}.
Activate Deadeye Navigator by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Deadeye Navigator enters the battlefield, its soulbond ability triggers, repairing it with another creature.
Repeat.

670-1619-6138-6473.notablePrerequisites: You are currently venturing in Tomb of Annihilation in the Trapped Entry room.
670-1619-6138-6473.description:
Cast Mardu Siegebreaker by paying its mana cost.
When Mardu Siegebreaker enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Mardu Siegebreaker trigger, exiling Bloodboil Sorcerer until Mardu Siegebreaker leaves the battlefield.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Mardu Siegebreaker.
Mardu Siegebreaker leaves the battlefield, causing Bloodboil Sorcerer to be returned to the battlefield from exile.
When Bloodboil Sorcerer enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Bloodboil Sorcerer trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Mardu Siegebreaker from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Mardu Siegebreaker enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Mardu Siegebreaker trigger, exiling Bloodboil Sorcerer until Mardu Siegebreaker leaves the battlefield.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger from step 10, venturing into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger from step 6, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Mardu Siegebreaker.
Repeat from step 5.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with three or more counters on it

687-2404-5412-6099.notablePrerequisites: There are three removable counters among creatures you control excluding the first three +1/+1 counters on Mossborn Hydra.
687-2404-5412-6099.description:
Activate Gaea's Cradle by tapping it, adding at least {3}.
Activate Coastal Hornclaw by sacrificing Gaea's Cradle.
Activate Tayam by paying {3} and removing three counters from creatures you control, causing you to mill three cards and return Gaea's Cradle from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Gaea's Cradle enters, Mossborn Hydra triggers, doubling the number of +1/+1 counters on it.
Repeat.
687-2404-5412-6099.notes: The prerequisite can be waived if Mossborn Hydra has six or more counters on it.

2034-2308-6772.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
2034-2308-6772.description:
Gain any amount of life.
Trudge Garden triggers, causing you to pay {2} to create a 4/4 Fungus Beast creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Fungus Beast, adding {C}{C}.
When the Fungus Beast dies, Syr Vondam triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and put a +1/+1 counter on Syr Vondam.
Repeat from step 2.

1066-1624-7439.description:
On the end step prior to your turn, cast Borne Upon the Wind by paying {1}{U}, drawing a card and allowing you to cast spells this turn as though they had flash.
Cast a copy of Channel from exile by paying {G}{G}, unpreparing Yavimaya Bloomsage.
Activate Channel by paying 1 life, adding {C}.
Repeat step 2 until you have exactly 1 life.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Near-Death Experience triggers, causing you to win the game.

856-2034-4321-6277.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Food.
856-2034-4321-6277.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food, returning Cauldron Familiar to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Cauldron Familiar and On Wings of Gold trigger.
Resolve the On Wings of Gold trigger, creating a token and a Food token.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Repeat

1322-4613-5310-5477-5627.easyPrerequisites: There is a land card in your library.
1322-4613-5310-5477-5627.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature other than Bloodghast that is untapped and that has a +1/+1 counter on it.
1322-4613-5310-5477-5627.description:
Activate a creature you control that has a +1/+1 counter on it by tapping it and sacrificing Bloodghast, searching your library for a land card and putting it onto the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Bloodghast triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Insidious Roots triggers, creating a 0/1 Plant creature token and then putting a +1/+1 counter on each Plant you control.
Repeat using the Plant instead until no lands are in your library.

1806-2060-2292-2445-7367.description:
Activate Eternal Scourge's scavenge ability, granted to it by Young Deathclaws, by paying {3} and exiling Eternal Scourge from your graveyard, putting six +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler due to Branching Evolution.
Activate Crystalline Crawler six times by removing six +1/+1 counters from it, adding {6}.
Cast Eternal Scourge from exile by paying {3}.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Eternal Scourge.
Repeat.

1115-6738-7011-7082.easyPrerequisites: You control three or more Allies.
1115-6738-7011-7082.description:
Cast Razor Boomerang by paying {0} due to Sokka, Swordmaster.
When Razor Boomerang enters, Sokka and Suki's second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token.
When the Ally enters, Sokka and Suki's first ability triggers, attaching Razor Boomerang to the Ally token.
Activate the Ally token by tapping it and unattaching Razor Boomerang, dealing 1 damage to any target and returning Razor Boomerang from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

11-1927-2575-7089.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill Fire Lord Azula
11-1927-2575-7089.description:
Declare Fire Lord Azula as an attacker, triggering its firebending ability, adding {R}{R}.
Holding priority, cast Temporal Mastery by paying its mana cost.
Fire Lord Azula's second ability triggers, copying Temporal Mastery.
Holding priority, cast Narset's Reversal by paying {U}{U}, targeting the original Temporal Mastery spell.
Fire Lord Azula's second ability triggers, copying Narset's Reversal, targeting the original Narset's Reversal.
Resolve the copy of Narset's Reversal, causing you to copy Narset's Reversal targeting the original Temporal Mastery spell, and then return the original Narset's Reversal to your hand.
Resolve the copy of Narset's Reversal, copying Temporal Mastery and returning the original Temporal Mastery to your hand.
Resolve both copies of Temporal Mastery from steps 3 and 7, causing you to take two extra turns after this one.
Repeat during your second extra turn.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature you control

338-3490-5231-6752.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
338-3490-5231-6752.description:
Gain life.
The creature with Light of Promise attached triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Haliya triggers, causing you to gain life.
The creature with Light of Promise attached triggers. Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Servo, adding {R}.
Resolve the trigger from the creature with Light of Promise attached, putting a +1/+1 counter on it 
Repeat from step 3.

225-539-872-3756.description:
Activate Scaled Herbalist by tapping it, putting Izzet Boilerworks from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Izzet Boilerworks enters, it and Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger.
Resolve the Izzet Boilerworks trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger, untapping it.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping Scaled Herbalist as it is a land due to Ashaya.
Repeat.

1350-4010-6723-6791.description:
Cast Farmer Cotton by paying at least {4}{G}{W}
When Farmer Cotton enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating at least four 1/1 Halfling creature tokens and four Food tokens.
Activate Farmer Cotton, four Halflings and four Foods by tapping them, adding {6}{G}{W}{W}.
Activate Meticulous Excavation by paying {2}{W}, returning Farmer Cotton from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
1350-4010-6723-6791.notes: It is recommended to pay at least {1} additional to start to get infinite untapped tokens. This mana will be recuperated throughout the combo.

1339-1477-2558-6666.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
1339-1477-2558-6666.description:
Draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
When the Insect enters the battlefield, Sword of the Meek triggers, returning Sword of the Meek from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the Insect.
When Sword of the Meek enters the battlefield, Rook Turret triggers.
Holding priority, activate Extruder by sacrificing Sword of the Meek.
Resolve the Rook Turret trigger, causing you to loot.
Repeat from step 2.

465-618-5686.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Wormfang Drake.
When the Wormfang Drake token enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Kiki-Jiki until Wormfang Drake leaves the battlefield.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing the Wormfang Drake token.
When the Wormfang Drake token dies, it triggers, returning Kiki-Jiki from exile to the battlefield.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.

4762-6189.easyPrerequisites: Devoted Druid does not have summoning sickness.
4762-6189.description:
Activate Devoted Druid's first ability by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Tyvar by paying {3}{G}{G}, giving creatures you control at least +3/+3 until end of turn.
Activate Devoted Druid's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Activate Devoted Druid's first ability by tapping it, adding {G}.
Repeat from step 3 until Devoted Druid is tapped and has exactly 1 toughness.
Repeat from step 1, increasing the +X/+X effect in step 1 each time.

245-1069-2079-5499.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three artifacts.
245-1069-2079-5499.description:
Activate Marneus Calgar by paying {6}, creating two 2/2 Astartes Warrior creature tokens.
When the Astartes Warriors enter the battlefield, Marneus Calgar triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Activate Lotus Ring's equip ability by paying {0} due to Puresteel Paladin, attaching it to an Astartes Warrior.
Activate the Astartes Warrior with Lotus Ring attached by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {3}.
Repeat from step 3 for the remaining Astartes Warrior.
Repeat from step 1.

7-586-2292-5258-5618.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one creature that has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
7-586-2292-5258-5618.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Rakdos triggers.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability from step 1, causing you to scry 1.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying at most {2}.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

3490-3910-4017-4094-5296.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least two additional artifacts.
Kaya has at least two loyalty counters on it.
3490-3910-4017-4094-5296.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Breya by paying {2} and sacrificing two other artifacts, causing you to gain 5 life.
Sunbond triggers, putting five +1/+1 counters on Workhorse
Animation Module triggers, holding priority, activate Workhorse three times by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Resolve the Animation Module trigger, causing you to pay {1} to create two 1/1 Servo artifact creature tokens.
Repeat from step 2.

168-526-4365-5193.manaNeeded: {2}{W}{B}{G} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
168-526-4365-5193.description:
Cast Anikthea from your hand or from the command zone by paying {2}{W}{B}{G} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Anikthea enters the battlefield, it and Life Finds a Way trigger.
Resolve the Anikthea trigger, exiling Oblivion Ring from your graveyard and creating two token copies of it that are 3/3 Zombies.
When the Oblivion Ring tokens enter the battlefield, their first abilities trigger.
Resolve the first Oblivion Ring trigger, exiling Anikthea until the Oblivion Ring token leaves the battlefield.
Resolve the second Oblivion Ring trigger, exiling the first Oblivion Ring token.
When the first Oblivion Ring token is exiled, Anikthea returns to the battlefield from exile.
When Anikthea enters the battlefield, it and Life Finds a Way trigger.
Resolve the Anikthea trigger, choosing not to exile anything.
Resolve the Life Finds a Way trigger, creating two token copies of the Oblivion Ring token.
Repeat from step 4.

824-2313-2464.notablePrerequisites:
Leech Bonder does not have summoning sickness.
Song of Freyalise has exactly one or two lore counters on it.
824-2313-2464.description:
Activate Leech Bonder by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Leech Bonder by paying {U} and untapping it, removing a +1/+1 counter from target creature and putting two +1/+1 counters on a different creature due to Conclave Mentor.
Repeat.

uses.n: Invasion of Segovia // Caetus, Sea Tyrant of Segovia

313-364-1170-1749-4113.description:
Cast Corpse Dance with buyback by tapping Caetus, Vampire Hexmage and one other creature you control.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Caetus and causing it to return to the battlefield as Invasion of Segovia.
When Invasion of Segovia enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating two 1/1 Kraken creature tokens.
Activate Vampire Hexmage by sacrificing it, removing all counters from Invasion of Segovia.
Invasion of Segovia triggers, causing you to exile it and cast it as Caetus, Sea Tyrant of Segovia.
Resolve Corpse Dance, returning Vampire Hexmage from your graveyard to the battlefield and returning Corpse Dance to your hand.
Repeat.

500-3362.description:
Cast Saw in Half by paying {2}{B}, destroying Bladewing and creating two token copies of it with base power equal to half the destroyed creature's power and base toughness equal to half the destroyed creature's toughness, rounding up each time.
Put one of the Bladewing tokens into your graveyard from the battlefield due to the legend rule.
The Bladewing tokens' enter-the-battlefield abilities trigger.
Resolve the first trigger, returning Bladewing from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Put Bladewing into your graveyard from the battlefield due to the legend rule.
Bladewing enter-the-battlefield ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 5.

751-1651-3263-3698.notablePrerequisites: You control a permanent that can tap to produce at least {2}.
751-1651-3263-3698.description:
Activate a permanent you control by tapping it, adding at least {2}.
Cast Shrieking Drake by paying {1}.
Shrieking Drake enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Grinding Station.
Resolve the Grinding Station trigger, untapping it.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping Grinding Station and Shrieking Drake, untapping the mana-producing permanent.
Resolve the Shrieking Drake trigger from step 3, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

2302-3082-4215-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Triumph of Saint Katherine.
Triumph of Saint Katherine dies, triggering itself and Verdant Succession.
Resolve the Triumph of Saint Katherine trigger, exiling it and the top six cards of your library into a face-down pile, then shuffling that pile and putting it on top of your library.
Resolve the Verdant Succession trigger, searching your library for Triumph of Saint Katherine and putting it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability from step 1, causing target player to mill cards equal to Triumph of Saint Katherine's power.
Repeat.

1479-2692-3257.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1479-2692-3257.description:
Play Rakdos Carnarium.
When Rakdos Carnarium enters the battlefield, it, Felidar Retreat, and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Rakdos Carnarium trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Felidar Retreat trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Rakdos Carnarium from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Rakdos Carnarium enters the battlefield, it and Felidar Retreat trigger.
Repeat from step 4.
